_source: Read out of Blockly 12.3.1 with the thrasos renderer on https://blockly-demo.appspot.com/static/tests/playground.html on 2026-09-12: renderer.getConstants(), makeRenderInfo_(block).measure() rows, and each block's svgPath_. Text widths are the browser's 11pt sans-serif.

constants.stroke: colourTertiary = fill mixed 30% towards white (#5b80a5 -> #8ca6c0), 1px; no dark path, no highlight; right corners square, left corners rounded where nothing is attached; value blocks square all round

rows.note: block = top row 5 (10 if the first input row has a statement) + input rows with spacer rows between + bottom row 5 (10 after a statement); the notch adds 4 below. Spacers: 10 between two plain rows, 4 before a statement row, 10 between two statement rows, 5 after a statement row before a plain one, 0 after the top row. Input row height = tallest element: text/field 18, icon 17, empty inline socket 26, filled inline socket = child height, empty external input 15, filled external input = child height - 10, empty statement 24, filled statement = child stack height incl. notch. Text centreline = row centre, except in a row with an inline socket or a statement: top + 9 + 5.
rows.spacing: start: 10 before a label or icon, 5 before an editable field, 8 before an inline socket, 20 before an unlabelled statement. Between: label/field 5, field/label 5, label/label 10, field/field 10, label->inline 8, label->external 8, field->inline 3, field->external 3, inline->label 10, inline->field 5, label->statement 10, field->statement 5. End: 10 after a label or an inline socket, 5 after a field, 0 after an external or statement input. External input element = 8 tab + 2 padding; a row stretched to the block width gets its slack before the external input.
rows.children: external child at (right edge - 8, row top - 5), i.e. its body starts at the parent's right edge and its own 5px top row sits above the parent's row; inline child at (cut-out left, cut-out top); statement child at (statement edge, row top); next block at y = body height (no dark-path pixel).

variables_set.rows: top 5 | input 18 (set, x▾, to, external 0) | bottom 5(+4)

math_number.field: rect 18.15x18 rx 4 at (13,5), text at x+5

controls_if_compare.rows: top 5 | input 28 (icon, if, external with 38-child: 38-10) | spacer 4 | statement 32 (do, child 28+4) | bottom 10(+4)

logic_compare.children: math_number at (16,5) and (92.15,5); dropdown rect at (57.15,10)

controls_if_else_empty.rows: top 5 | input 18 | spacer 4 | statement 24 | spacer 10 | statement 24 | bottom 10(+4); one statement edge (else is wider than do)

controls_repeat_empty_with_two_children.rows: top 5 | inline 26 (empty socket) | spacer 4 | statement 60 (28+28+4) | bottom 10(+4)

text_print_stack.note: square bottom-left when a next block is attached; next block at y = 28

procedures_defreturn.rows: top 5 | 18 | spacer 4 | statement 32 | spacer 5 | external 18 | bottom 5; no notches, rounded left corners
